lastResponse.text: That sounds urgent, and you did the right thing calling. Stay with me while we get you to a housing legal specialist now. If you can, call the Eviction Defense Project at 8 8 8, 5 8 5, 9 6 3 8. If that line is busy, call 8 0 0, 6 7 2, 4 9 1 9. They help people with eviction notices and can act fast.
